summary: Smoke test after requirements.txt trim (removed emergentintegrations/boto3/motor/pymongo/pandas/numpy). Backend starts cleanly on FastAPI+SQLAlchemy async+asyncpg. All 18 backend pytest tests pass (auth for 3 roles, apps listing/scoping, submissions with auto-increment 'numero', Spanish 400 for missing required fields, admin CRUD with 403 for non-admin). Frontend loads, admin logs in, sees all 5 app cards, opens Reclamaciones, and Registros tab renders backend submissions with auto-generated numero (1,2,3). Trimmed deps did not break anything.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is clean and matches server.py imports; no unused runtime deps.

CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default when CORS_ORIGINS unset) is invalid per spec and rejected by browsers; harmless behind ingress here but set explicit origins in prod.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers for future upgrades.
seed_admin path: existing admin password is reset when it doesn't match ADMIN_PASSWORD, but session.commit() only happens later — OK here since same session, just noting.
next_counter update+insert has a small race window under concurrent first-submit; fine for corporate volume but not for high concurrency.
seed_data_creation: 3 reclamaciones submissions created during tests (TEST_ prefix); left in DB as evidence for frontend Registros view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend on PostgreSQL (portal_db / user 'portal'). Auth is Bearer JWT (no cookies). All backend endpoints validated in /app/backend/tests/test_portal.py. Reclamaciones has auto-increment 'numero' via Counter table. Frontend uses shadcn Select (role=combobox) for categoria/prioridad — use role-based selectors.
